 Description
 We are seeking a talented Senior Engineer with strong Front end experience and a proven track record of building high quality scalable web applications, and solid leadership abilities. You will be responsible for implementing pixel perfect designs that balance challenging customer needs with application performance. 
 

 Requirements: - 
 BS in Computer Science or related technical field required. MS/PhD is highly desirable. - 
 

 Qualified Full Stack Engineer with strong emphasis on Front End Experience with proven experience with Angular.js, Backbone.js, Node.js and Javascript. 
 

 - 5-7 years of experience in Ruby on Rails, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS3, AJAX, Responsive Design, and general Web 2.0 techniques in the context of interactive Web Applications 
 

 - 5-7 years with Java, J2EE Technologies, Spring Framework, Hibernate, iBatis, POJO, with BE experience around Java and J2EE technologies 
 

 - 5-7 years with XML and XSLT technology 
 

 - 5-7 years building fast and efficient web applications 
 

 - 5+ years experience in a Senior/ Lead capacity


 Multiple Openings for OPT/CPT/H4/L2/EAD/Citizen's.
